row.notes: Constructor of the per-car lap times block (about 0x9CB8 bytes), returns self. Builds 200 lap records of 200 bytes at +0x8 with Sess_LapRecord_Construct and writes the lap index into byte 0 of each; zeroes uint16 +0x0 and byte +0x9C48, sets uint16 +0x9CB0 = 0xFFFF. Six obfuscated int32 fields at +0x9C50, +0x9C60, +0x9C70, +0x9C80, +0x9C90, +0x9CA0 each have an 8-byte random key at +8 (two g_Car_ObfRng draws, RNG lazily seeded from QueryPerformanceCounter) and are initialised to the key low dword, i.e. plain value 0; decode as stored XOR key low dword. Good hook for knowing when a car's lap table is created.
